description: The Chinese Dynamic Map is based on the size of numerical columns in China's administrative divisions (such as provinces, cities, and counties), with the color intensity changing accordingly. It also supports the display of one or more columns of scatter plots (in various forms such as numbers, text, icons, etc.), and also supports the display of data at the next level of China's administrative divisions. It not only supports the complete data display of Chinese administrative regions, but also supports the partial data display of Chinese administrative regions. It provides color schemes for numerical columns, various styles for scatter column settings, labels, legends, highlighting, report tooltips, interactions with different visual objects, and also supports tooltip reports. This visual object is applicable to business scenarios such as sales analysis, market distribution, operation monitoring, risk assessment, customer coverage, and regional performance of China's administrative divisions.
